title: 第十一章 超青藏高原77第十一章 超青藏高原76
content_zh:
十四、信任之环的真相中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟四个人知道历史。
那段历史是这样记录的——信任城的市民因为战斗中失去了信任之环，情绪更加极端暴躁，对勇者充满了愤恨，也有一部分市民维护勇者，双方吵得不可开交。
此时诺诺曹带着强化后的机体直接袭击城市，翔天因为市民之前的埋怨，而变得情绪低落。
幸好奈奈用激将法，和城里面的父老乡亲鼓励大气，让翔天重新燃起斗志战胜了敌人。
那是没有逆转时空之前的原始历史。现在不同了。信任城的市民因为战斗中失去了信任之环，情绪更加极端暴躁。
一部分市民对勇者充满了愤恨——
“都是你们把怪物引来的！信任之环没了，我们怎么办！”另一部分市民维护勇者——
“要不是他们挡住岩浆，你们连站在这里骂人的机会都没有！”双方吵得不可开交。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟不会受到这种情况影响。
他们知道真相，信任之环从来就不是真正的力量来源。但中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界引导者猫人族小女孩美雅受到了影响。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天站在街道上，听着市民们的骂声和维护声混在一起，情绪变得低落。
他低着头，看着自己的双手，没有说话。此时诺诺曹带着强化后的机体直接袭击城市。
强化后的诺诺曹机甲体型更大，装甲更厚，暗紫色核心跳动着更强烈的不祥光芒。
他选择了中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天情绪最低落的时候进攻。
翔天站在原地，没有立刻召唤烈风。中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈看了他一眼，没有安慰他，而是走到他面前，大声说：“你就这点本事？几个市民骂你两句，你就站不起来了？你是元气勇者，不是来听表扬的！城里面的父老乡亲们——那些刚才在维护你们的人，他们还在等你们保护他们！你站不站得起来？”城里面的父老乡亲们围了过来。
一个老妇人拄着拐杖走到中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天面前，把一只手放在他肩上。
另一个中年男人扛着铁锹站在中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树旁边，拍了拍亚树的后背。
他们什么都没说，但他们的手没有收回去。中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天抬起头。
他看到了中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈的眼睛，看到了老妇人放在自己肩上的手，看到了中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树身边那个扛铁锹的中年男人。
他抬起右腕，召唤器固定在手腕上，徽、插在召唤器中。

“烈风！”元气金刚烈风拔地而起，赤红色装甲在火山灰笼罩的天空下燃烧如一团火焰。
神光剑在烈风手中。中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈抬起右腕。
“流影飞狐！”流影飞狐拔地而起。暴冰熊同时降临，冰晶拳套在熔岩的余热中蒸腾出白雾。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树抬起右腕。
“震地龙！”震地龙拔地而起。中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧抬起右腕。
“猛风！”猛风降临，白光狼同时现身。中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖抬起右腕。
“地震龙！”地震龙降临。中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯抬起右腕。
“光影飞虎！”光影飞虎降临，冰企鹅同时现身。三尊元气金刚加金光狮与暴冰熊，三尊白元金刚加白光狼与冰企鹅，六尊金刚加四名圣兽与超兽战士，在信任城的街道上一字排开。
诺诺曹机甲冲过来。烈风与猛风并肩，神光烈风斩与天光猛风斩同时斩下，红黑剑气与赤蓝剑气交织。
震地龙与地震龙双钻头合并，双钻爆裂与天钻爆裂同时命中。流影飞狐与光影飞虎双弓齐发，流影箭与光影穿梭同时贯穿。
金光狮狮吼爆破斩，白光狼狼嚎爆破斩，暴冰熊天地裂冰，冰企鹅混沌重冰。
所有的攻击在同一个瞬间汇合，诺诺曹机甲的暗紫色核心在所有光芒的交汇点上炸裂。
强化后的机体在绝对的力量面前四分五裂，诺诺曹从驾驶舱中滚落出来，倒在信任城的石板路上。
这一次他没有逃脱。诺诺曹失败了。战斗结束。市民们的争吵声渐渐平息下来。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧站了出来，她的声音不大，但整条街道都能听到。
“其实信任之环，根据我们所知，信任之环与友爱之环本来就是不存在的。根据元气星魂世界资料，远古时期，灵心用双手封印天隆，天隆并没有说出我不甘心，反而说好温暖的。有正面能量——灵心、结合地球上人们希望、盼望、祈祷——化为奇迹大陆。奇迹大陆，也叫奇幻世界，是一个星球的名字。漫长岁月累积的负面能量超越正面能量，强大负面能量扭曲了天隆的内心，变成大魔王，而且记忆也被扭曲了。地球上人们为了纪念灵心与闪灵骑士的牺牲，才创造了这两个环。人们从来不会依赖这两个环，只是随着漫长岁月，奇迹大陆上当地人早就忘记了真相。翔峰知道灵心身化为宇宙，所以灵心并没有死亡。远古时期的那颗星球叫地球，而现在叫蓝星。”信任城的街道上一片寂静。
市民们互相看着彼此，那些刚才还在争吵的嘴缓缓闭上。他们低头看着自己的双手——这双手不需要握住信任之环，也可以握住彼此。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
14. The truth about the Ring of Trust: the little girl Huang Xuejing from the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, the little girl Yang Xinying from the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, the little boy Tang Qiongkai from the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World Wisdom, and the little boy Hu Wei from the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World giant panda beast know the history.
That period of history is recorded like this - because the citizens of Trust City lost the ring of trust during the battle, their mood became even more extreme and violent, and they were full of resentment towards the brave. Some citizens also defended the brave, and the two sides quarreled fiercely.
At this time, Nonochio directly attacked the city with the strengthened machine. Xiangtian became depressed because of the previous complaints from the citizens.
Fortunately, Nana used provocation and encouraged Xiangtian with the villagers in the city, so Xiangtian regained his fighting spirit and defeated the enemy.
That was the original history before time and space were reversed. It's different now. The citizens of Trust City became even more extreme and irritable because they lost their rings of trust during the battle.
Some citizens are full of resentment towards the brave——
"It's all you who attracted the monsters! The ring of trust is gone, what should we do!" Another part of the citizens defended the brave——
"If they hadn't blocked the lava, you wouldn't even have had the chance to stand here and curse!" The two sides started arguing.
The little girl Huang Xuejing from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, the little girl Yang Xinying from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, the little boy Tang Qiongkai from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World Wisdom, and the little boy Hu Wei from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World Panda Beast will not be affected by this situation.
They know the truth, that the Circle of Trust has never been a true source of power. However, China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World's brave boy Xiangtian, China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World's Power Brave boy Yashu, China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World's Wisdom Brave little girl Tian Nana, and China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World Leader Cat-human girl Meiya were affected.
The young boy Xiangtian stood on the street, listening to the citizens' scoldings and voices of defense mixed together, and his mood became depressed.
He lowered his head, looked at his hands, and said nothing. At this time, Nonochio directly attacked the city with the strengthened machine.
The strengthened Nonochio mecha is larger, has thicker armor, and its dark purple core pulses with a stronger ominous light.
He chose to attack when Xiangtian, a young boy from China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors, was at his lowest mood.
Xiangtian stood there and did not immediately summon Gale Wind. The little girl Tian Nana glanced at him, but instead of comforting him, she walked up to him and said loudly: "That's all you have? A few citizens scolded you, and you couldn't stand up anymore. ? You are a brave man, not here to be praised! The folks in the city - those who were defending you just now, are still waiting for you to protect them! "Can you stand up?" The folks in the city gathered around.
An old woman walked up to Xiangtian, a young boy from China's Low-Level Technology Thunderbolt Warriors and the World of Brave Warriors, with a cane, and put a hand on his shoulder.
Another middle-aged man carrying a shovel stood next to Yashu, a young boy from China's Low-Level Technology Thunderbolt Warriors, Vitality Braves, World Power Braves, and patted Yashu on the back.
They didn't say anything, but they didn't take their hands back. The little boy Xiangtian raised his head.
He saw the eyes of Tian Nana, the little girl of wisdom and courage in the world of low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors of China, saw the old woman’s hand on his shoulder, and saw the world of vitality and bravery of China’s low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors.The middle-aged man carrying a shovel next to the little boy Ashu, the Hero of Power.
He raised his right wrist, the summoner was fixed on his wrist, and the emblem was inserted into the summoner.
"Gale wind!" A gale force rose from the ground, the red armor burning like a ball of flame under the sky shrouded in volcanic ash.
The divine light sword is in Liefeng's hand. The little girl Tian Nana raised her right wrist.
"Liuying Flying Fox!" Liuying Flying Fox rises from the ground. The ice bear came at the same time, and the ice crystal gloves evaporated into white mist in the residual heat of the lava.
The young boy Yashu raised his right wrist.
"Earthquake Dragon!" Earthquake Dragon rises from the ground. The little girl Huang Xuejing raised her right wrist.
"Fierce wind!" The fierce wind came, and the white light wolf appeared at the same time. The little girl Yang Xinying, a person of low-level technology in China's Baiyuan Brave World, raised her right wrist.
"Earthquake Dragon!" The Earthquake Dragon came. The little boy Tang Qiongkai of the Chinese Low-Level Technology White Yuan Brave World Wisdom raised his right wrist.
"Light and Shadow Flying Tiger!" The Light and Shadow Flying Tiger descended, and the Ice Penguin appeared at the same time. Three vitality Vajras plus golden light lions and violent ice bears, three white yuan Vajras plus white light wolves and ice penguins, six Vajras plus four holy beasts and super beast warriors are lined up on the streets of Trust City.
Mecha Nonochio rushed over. Gale and fierce wind go hand in hand, the Divine Light Gale Wind Slash and the Sky Light Gale Wind Slash are slashed at the same time, the red and black sword energy interweaves with the red and blue sword energy.
Earthquake Dragon and Earthquake Dragon's twin drills merge, and Twin Diamond Explosion and Sky Diamond Explosion hit at the same time. The Liuying Flying Fox and the Light and Shadow Flying Tiger fired their bows at the same time, and the Liuying Arrow and the Light and Shadow shuttle penetrated at the same time.
The golden light lion roars and explodes, the white light wolf howls and explodes, the ice bear breaks the ice, and the ice penguin creates chaos and heavy ice.
All the attacks converged at the same moment, and the dark purple core of the Nonochio mecha exploded at the intersection of all the lights.
The strengthened body was torn apart in the face of absolute power, and Nonochio rolled out of the cockpit and fell on the stone road of Trust City.
This time he didn't escape. Nonocchio failed. The battle is over. The quarrels among the citizens gradually subsided.
The little girl Huang Xuejing, a brave person from the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan World, stood up. Her voice was not loud, but the whole street could hear it.
"Actually, the ring of trust, according to what we know, the ring of trust and the ring of friendship did not exist. According to the data of the Yuanqi Star Soul World, in ancient times, the spirit heart sealed Tianlong with both hands. Tianlong did not say that I was unwilling, but said it was warm. There is positive energy - the spirit heart, combined with the hopes, hopes, and prayers of people on the earth - turned into a miracle continent. Miracle Continent, also called a fantasy world, is the name of a planet. The negative energy accumulated over long years exceeds the positive energy. The powerful negative energy distorted Tianlong's heart, and his memory was also distorted. People on the earth created these two rings to commemorate the sacrifices of the spirit heart and the Shining Knight. However, over time, the locals on the Miracle Continent have long forgotten the truth. Xiangfeng knew that the spirit heart transformed into the universe, so the planet in ancient times was called the Earth, and now it is called Blue Star. "There was silence on the streets of Trust City.
The citizens looked at each other, and those who were arguing just now slowly closed their mouths. They looked down at their hands—hands that didn't need to hold the Ring of Trust to hold each other.
